task_description: Complete the partially implemented annotation system for the AFL coaching board. Add text labels, improved arrows with arrowheads, zone highlighting, free-hand drawing, selection/edit/delete capabilities, and ensure proper persistence with playbooks.

patterns.zustand_store_pattern: All stores use create<StateInterface>() with typed actions. See playerStore.ts for reference with get() and set() patterns.
patterns.threejs_component_pattern: Use declarative JSX with @react-three/fiber. See Field.tsx for line/mesh patterns using bufferGeometry and bufferAttribute.
patterns.dexie_persistence_pattern: PlaybookDatabase extends Dexie with Table types. Use version() for schema migrations. See playbookStore.ts.
patterns.raycasting_pattern: useAnnotationInteraction.ts shows raycaster.ray.intersectPlane for field plane intersection.
patterns.field_coordinate_system: Use field-space coordinates [x, y, z] where y=0 is field surface. snapToField() in fieldGeometry.ts constrains to oval bounds.

existing_implementations.description: Annotation system is partially implemented with basic rendering and interaction
what_exists: Annotation interface with id, type, points, color, thickness, text, createdAt
Zustand store with addAnnotation, removeAnnotation, clearAnnotations, setSelectedTool, setSelectedColor, setThickness
AnnotationToolbar with tool selection UI, color picker, and thickness slider
useAnnotationInteraction hook with click-and-drag using raycaster.ray.intersectPlane
AnnotationLayer component with rendering shells for all types
LineAnnotation renders using bufferGeometry (but no arrowhead)
RectangleAnnotation renders using planeGeometry with opacity
TextAnnotation renders white rectangle placeholder (no actual text)
Playbook save/load includes annotations field (annotations?: any[])
usePlaybook hook saves and restores annotations with setState
what_needs_completion: TextAnnotation needs @react-three/drei Text component for actual text rendering and text input capability
Arrows need arrowhead cone geometry at end point to show direction
Free-hand drawing not implemented (need continuous path capture, not just start/end points)
Selection mechanism missing - can't click annotation to select it for editing
Edit capabilities missing - no draggable handles for repositioning or resizing
Individual delete missing - toolbar only has 'Clear All' button
Type definitions need discriminated unions for type safety per annotation type
Validation for empty/invalid annotations (empty text, zero-length arrows, etc.)
selectedAnnotation field needs to be added to store for tracking selection
